title: Kitchen
dek: Cookware, knives and bakeware that held up in independent testing and are built to last for decades.

boards.title: Pans for life
boards.dek: Cast iron, carbon steel and enameled iron that go from stovetop to oven.

boards.title: Knife and board
boards.dek: A long-running top-pick chef's knife and an end-grain board that is easy on its edge.

boards.title: Test-kitchen bakeware
boards.dek: Pans that America's Test Kitchen picked in its own testing.

items.name: No. 12 Cast Iron Skillet
items.why: The cast-iron skillet on America's Test Kitchen's essentials list: a US-made 12-inch skillet with Smithey's polished interior and a 10.5-inch cooking surface. It is heavy, at about 8.7 lb.

items.name: Farmhouse Carbon Steel Skillet
items.why: A carbon steel skillet hand-forged by a blacksmith in Charleston, SC. At about 5 lb for a 12-inch pan with a 9-inch cooking surface, it is much lighter than the 8.7 lb No. 12 in cast iron.

items.name: The Dutchess Enameled Cast Iron Dutch Oven
items.why: A 6.75-quart enameled cast iron Dutch oven that works on induction and in the oven to 500°F. It comes in six matte colors, including Blueberry and Broccoli.

items.name: Professional Series 8" Chef's Knife with Dimples (MTH-80)
items.why: Mac says Wirecutter has recommended the MTH-80 as its top chef's knife since 2013. The blade is 7.88 inches long and 2.5 mm thick, with dimples along the edge, and the knife weighs 6.5 oz.

items.name: Maple End Grain Cutting Board, 12 x 18 in
items.why: A 2-inch-thick end-grain board in FSC-certified hard maple, made to order in Texas; end grain is gentler on knife edges than long grain. The Boardsmith says Serious Eats, Wirecutter and America's Test Kitchen have all recommended this board.
items.ebay: boardsmith maple end grain cutting board

items.name: 9-Inch Leakproof Springform Pan (1086SF)
items.why: America's Test Kitchen's winning springform in its June 2026 review, where it 'produced picture-perfect cake and cheesecake.' It is aluminized steel with a nonstick coating and is oven-safe to 450°F.

items.name: 9-Inch Nonstick Pie Pan (1100PE)
items.why: The pie pan on America's Test Kitchen's essentials list: a 9-inch aluminized steel pan with a nonstick silicone coating, made in the USA.
